name: Do I need to hire separate contractors for different finish work tasks?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire separate contractors for different finish work tasks?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Maine Results, Inc., you typically do not need to hire separate contractors for different finish work tasks. As a general contractor for home additions, we manage all aspects of the finish work, from drywall and painting to flooring and fixture installation. This process clarity streamlines communication and ensures a cohesive project flow. We coordinate all trades, which can affect the overall timing and complexity, but ultimately simplifies the process for the homeowner.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, as your general contractor, Maine Results, Inc. manages all finish work tasks, coordinating trades for a streamlined process.
